title: Ice and Fire CE x Magic Coins Compat
description: This datapack amends the loot drop for Gold and Silver piles added by Ice and Fire CE to drop Silver and Gold Coins from Magic Coins!
body:
This datapack amends the loot drop for Gold and Silver piles added by Ice and Fire CE to drop Silver and Gold Coins from Magic Coins!

I created this pack for use in my modpack [Hexes and Hoodoo](https://modrinth.com/modpack/hexes-and-hoodoo), which utilises both Ice and Fire CE and Magic Coins. This pack was suggested by a play tester who believed that Ice and Fire's Gold and Silver piles presented a good opportunity to integrate Magic Coins' currency into the world's loot.
